title: The Counterintuitive Physics of Turning a Bike
summary: A two-minute minutephysics video explaining why turning a bicycle requires first steering briefly the other way. It covers counter-steering and balance with slow-motion footage and 3D animation.
why: HN cites it as a quick illustration of countersteering, the idea that you must first turn the opposite way to lean into a turn.

quote.text: Really highlights how you have to throw a bike slightly into the opposite direction[0] to a turn in order to get it to turn.
